scenes: What if you can’t leave when it’s too hot?
Some people can’t go to shade, or a cooling centre: | people in prisons, hostels, care homes and crowded shelters.
Tamil Nadu’s heat strategy names prisoners among the groups it is meant to reach, | and proposes cool roofs and trees for its jails.
Whoever holds the key holds the duty of care.
Heat plans that reach every building.
